THE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH_READ_THIS_FIRST.claim: The receipts CANNOT adjudicate the section-2 prediction, and a naive read of them manufactures a spurious ~3% disagreement WITH THE SIGN OF (ratio-1) FLIPPED. The two numbers are different quantities.
THE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH_READ_THIS_FIRST.the_recorder_records_the_push_AT_CONSUMP: closure_foldforward_instrumented.py:115 hooks RunStep1, so with niter=3 it records the push entering iterations 0, 1 and 2 -- i.e. after 0, 1 and 2 RunStep2 passes. Line 243-246 asserts len(records)==niter, so the row count is right and the series is complete FOR THAT QUANTITY.
THE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH_READ_THIS_FIRST.the_push_left_by_the_LAST_RunStep2_is_re: RunStep2(niter-1) leaves a push that no RunStep1 ever consumes, so the recorder never sees it. It IS persisted, as `weights_push` in the run's .npz (closure_powered_truth_reweight.py:337, 351).
THE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH_READ_THIS_FIRST.and_the_END_OF_RUN_push_is_the_one_the_N: train_fullevent_nominal.py:576-577 computes sum_w_push_reco / sum_w_reco from `push` AFTER Unfold(), on the reco leg over mc.pass_reco. So the nominal's recorded 0.736746250130697 -- the 34% deficit the whole OI-71/OI-125 argument is about -- is the END-OF-RUN scalar, and the like-for-like closure number is the one recovered here, NOT any row the instrumentation writes.
THE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH_READ_THIS_FIRST.consequence_for_OI_125: The instrument narrows the receipt-chain hole but does not close it: dev = |ratio/R - 1| is now formable per iteration for this configuration, and it is NOT formable from any receipt for the quantity that is like-for-like with the nominal's recorded scalar. That one is still a reconstruction -- this session's, as the executor lane's 1.011418 was.

VERDICT_vs_section_2.tolerance_stated_plainly: The predeclaration set no numeric tolerance for this comparison, so the honest one is the run's own draw spread. 1.011418 is a SINGLE draw of the same configuration (run 56552326), so the right question is whether it is consistent with being a fourth draw: it sits 1.17 prediction-sd above the three-draw mean. It is NOT inside the three-draw range -- it is 1.0e-04 above the max, 0.26 sd -- and that is stated rather than smoothed over, because at n=3 a range is not a confidence interval. AGREE at the draw-spread tolerance; and emphatically NOT the -3% / 105-sd / sign-flipped disagreement a naive read of the last recorded row produces.
what_this_does_NOT_say: It does not make 1.011418 a RECORDED value. It remains a reconstruction, and so does the number above -- OI-125's hole is narrowed, not closed.
It does not close OI-71 G4 by itself; that row's remaining content is recovery at the PROMOTED configuration, and this is a closure.
It says nothing about the nominal run's 34% deficit, whose magnitude is untouched here. This closure's fold-forward is ~1.011, so it still does not exercise it.

RESULT_2_arm1_delta_recovery.section_6_declared_in_advance: a ~1% rescale may move recovery by LESS than the draw spread 0.00082, in which case arm 1 is underpowered by construction and the honest report is a BOUND, not a null
RESULT_2_arm1_delta_recovery.what_happened_instead: the effect is 8.4x the declared draw spread and 16.2x the within-arm pooled sd, with disjoint arm ranges -- so this is NOT the bound section 6 expected, and the reason is section 5's amplitude, measured below
RESULT_2_arm1_delta_recovery.sign: NEGATIVE -- the scale-only correction makes recovery WORSE on this closure

exact_permutation_test.reading: 0.1 is the FLOOR at 3 vs 3 -- complete separation cannot do better than 2/20, so the permutation p is bounded by the design and is NOT evidence of weakness. Reported because the alternative -- a fitted gaussian tail on n=3 -- is what BEN-025 forbids.

RESULT_2_arm1_delta_recovery.the_honest_statement: |Delta recovery| = 0.006888 at 3 draws per arm, effect NEGATIVE, arm ranges disjoint, 9 of 9 realized pairwise differences in the same direction and all exceeding both spread scales. This is a MEASURED EFFECT, not a bound and not a null. It is 0.38 of the margin, so both arms still clear the adopted criterion.

the_four_285_cell_spectra_vs_run_5655232.reading: three of the four are BIT-IDENTICAL, which is the strong form of section 1's `1e-9`. The fourth, h_unfolded, is the TRAINED spectrum and cannot be 1e-9-identical across independent draws -- its scatter IS the draw spread the gate is stated against, and stating it as a pass at 1e-9 would be meaningless. Section 1's other clause -- recovery inside the measured three-draw band -- is the one that binds h_unfolded, and it passes.

SECTION_6_AMPLITUDE_PREMISE_WAS_WRONG_AN.reading: section 6 sized the perturbation off the END-OF-RUN ratio and the correction is applied to the CONSUMED one -- the SAME conflation that makes the receipts look like they contradict section 2. The two errors are one error, and it cuts both ways: it made section 2 look refuted and section 6 look conservative. Arm 1 measures the sensitivity of recovery to a ~4.6% fold-forward rescale at iteration 1, NOT the ~1% section 6 declared, and STILL not the effect of correcting a 34% deficit.
